items.title: High Level UKPNP Delegation Led by Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri Meets Baroness Emma Nicholson in London
items.excerpt: UKPNP delegation holds high level political briefing in London with Baroness Emma Nicholson on Kashmir developments and international follow up.
items.author: Special Correspondent

heroImage.caption: UKPNP delegation meets Baroness Emma Nicholson in London.

body.text: A high level delegation of the United Kashmir People’s National Party, UKPNP, led by its Exiled Chairman Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri, held a formal meeting and briefing with Baroness Emma Nicholson, Member of the House of Lords of the United Kingdom.

Baroness Nicholson has been a life peer since 1997 and previously served as Member of the European Parliament, Rapporteur on Kashmir, and Former Vice President of the European Parliament’s Committee on Foreign Affairs, Human Rights, Common Defense, and Security Policy.

items: Access to essential services is a state obligation
Emergency powers must not violate freedoms

body.caption: Delegation briefing Baroness Nicholson in London.

body.text: The meeting focused on political conditions in all regions of the historical State of Jammu and Kashmir, human rights challenges, and developments since the 2007 European Parliament Report.
